generated_examples.rule: Each source row becomes one research-only example with the same official URL, fact, gate and confidence. No parcel relation, network headroom, offer, queue place, energisation date or Future Growth score is inferred.

second_pass_examples.rule: Each source row is rendered a second time as a fail-closed control. Portal/map/register/process/product presence remains separate from formal connection study, offer acceptance, firm capacity and energisation.

third_pass_examples.rule: Each source row is rendered a third time as a temporal/contractual control. Currentness, queue state, flexible/non-firm terms and indicative-vs-formal evidence are rechecked before any promotion.

extra_examples.fact: NESO explicitly states Gate 1 does not reserve capacity, queue position or guarantee connection.
extra_examples.gate: Do not score Gate 1 as positive network capacity.

extra_examples.fact: Gate 2 can carry a confirmed connection date, point and queue position only for projects that meet readiness and strategic criteria.
extra_examples.gate: Do not infer Gate 2 from regional/zonal data.

extra_examples.fact: The 10 June 2026 milestone is an aggregate pipeline measure.
extra_examples.gate: Do not convert an aggregate offer percentage into a site's probability of offer.

extra_examples.fact: Reform timelines define offer-issuance windows extending into 2027.
extra_examples.gate: Offer timing is not construction completion or energisation timing.

extra_examples.fact: NESO marks parts of the old connection-offer page as no longer current.
extra_examples.gate: Prefer current reform pages over legacy process text.

extra_examples.ref: Demand reform policy not final decision
extra_examples.fact: Ofgem's June 2026 demand reform update describes policy development for queue curation and prioritisation.
extra_examples.gate: Emerging reform work is not a site-specific connection approval.

extra_examples.fact: UKPN open data exposes assets, capacity and utilisation for discovery.
extra_examples.gate: Formal application and offer evidence remain required for a target development.

extra_examples.fact: GSP visibility can show spare capacity and queue context.
extra_examples.gate: Visible headroom is not capacity reserved for a new applicant.

extra_examples.ref: Appendix G summary versus connection acceptance
extra_examples.fact: Pre-application resources include Appendix G and network-plan context.
extra_examples.gate: Summary data does not equal an accepted connection offer.

extra_examples.fact: Ramped connections increase available capacity according to an agreed schedule.
extra_examples.gate: Future ramp capacity must not be treated as available from day one.

extra_examples.fact: Flexible DER connections can be curtailed to remain within network limits.
extra_examples.gate: Non-firm capacity must not be scored as unrestricted firm capacity.

extra_examples.fact: Profiled connections vary maximum demand by time window.
extra_examples.gate: Off-peak maximum capacity is not continuous all-day headroom.

extra_examples.fact: NGED says its network-capacity map does not replace a formal application.
extra_examples.gate: Map colour alone cannot be promoted to connection-ready status.

extra_examples.fact: NGED notes capacity-map figures change as quotations are issued and expire.
extra_examples.gate: Re-read current data before relying on prior headroom.

extra_examples.fact: The budget estimate is indicative and excludes several site/legal items.
extra_examples.gate: Indicative cost is not engineering approval or reserved capacity.

extra_examples.fact: NGED distinguishes budget estimates from formal connection offers.
extra_examples.gate: Keep estimate, offer, acceptance and energisation as separate states.

extra_examples.fact: Storage G99 requires technical documents and a connection application.
extra_examples.gate: Submission is not permission to energise or export.

extra_examples.fact: SSEN capacity information indicates major-substation capability.
extra_examples.gate: A connection study/offer remains required for exact site demand or generation.

extra_examples.fact: Large housing applications specify site layout and expected electricity use.
extra_examples.gate: Requested capacity is not accepted or deliverable capacity.

extra_examples.fact: SSEN identifies design, readiness and material lead times as delay factors.
extra_examples.gate: Do not convert generic process stages into a guaranteed power-on date.

extra_examples.fact: The LCT dataset aggregates installed/connected technology capacity at primary substations.
extra_examples.gate: Installed capacity is not spare headroom.

extra_examples.fact: ENWL says detailed formal assessment is more accurate than its heatmap.
extra_examples.gate: Use heatmap only for screening, not approval.

extra_examples.ref: ENWL total capacity versus single connection
extra_examples.fact: Heatmap spare capacity can represent total capacity available to connections.
extra_examples.gate: Do not treat it as the maximum feasible size of one connection.

extra_examples.fact: Connection timing varies with permits, land rights, reinforcement and engineering complexity.
extra_examples.gate: Do not store average timing as a site-specific delivery date.

extra_examples.fact: SPEN states the webpage heatmap uses October 2025 data and is no longer updated.
extra_examples.gate: Use the Open Data Portal rather than the stale embedded map.

extra_examples.fact: SPEN alternative offers include ANM and other non-firm arrangements.
extra_examples.gate: Alternative offers are not equivalent to firm unrestricted access.

extra_examples.fact: Technical Limits can accelerate eligible connections ahead of reinforcement with ANM/curtailment.
extra_examples.gate: Accelerated connection remains conditional and non-firm.

extra_examples.fact: Transmission heatmaps use TEC information for high-level context.
extra_examples.gate: TEC/heatmap presence is not a connection offer.

extra_examples.fact: Northern Powergrid ECR includes both connected and accepted-to-connect assets.
extra_examples.gate: Do not collapse accepted-to-connect into energised status.

extra_examples.ref: ECR project capacity versus spare capacity
extra_examples.fact: ECR reports project capacity and status.
extra_examples.gate: Existing/contracted project capacity is not network spare headroom.

extra_examples.fact: Portal dashboards aggregate data by GSP, primary substation or authority.
extra_examples.gate: Aggregated dashboard values are not a project-specific study.

extra_examples.fact: NESO says RESP boundaries in reform results are contextual and do not replace operational connection zones.
extra_examples.gate: Do not use RESP geography as the project connection zone.

extra_examples.fact: Ofgem approved phased G2tWQ offer milestones.
extra_examples.gate: Regulatory milestones do not guarantee an individual project's offer date.

extra_examples.fact: UKPN offers several large-demand connection products, including ramped and profiled options.
extra_examples.gate: Product catalogue presence does not prove a data-centre site can obtain the requested load.

extra_examples.fact: NGED warns typical published prices may differ from actual project costs.
extra_examples.gate: Do not use generic pricing as a candidate viability input without a site quote.

extra_examples.fact: The feature-page dataset is an index of dashboards and resources.
extra_examples.gate: Discovery metadata alone must not create a capacity or connection record.
